# NurdiansyahLabs

> NurdiansyahLabs is the software engineering platform, portfolio, and digital studio operated by Nurdiansyah. It delivers fullstack web applications, business dashboards, and custom operational ERP systems.

## Primary Entities
- Name: Nurdiansyah
- Brand: NurdiansyahLabs
- Website: https://nurdiansyahlabs.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Nurdiansyah0
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nurdiansyah-ds

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Python 3.13, Flask 3.1.3 (Modular Monolith architecture), Native WSGI
- Database: PostgreSQL 13, SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM, Alembic Migrations
- Deployment: CloudLinux, LiteSpeed Web Server, Phusion Passenger WSGI

## Key Showcase Projects & Systems
- Primatera Poultry ERP: End-to-end digital farm management system tracking flock feed, mortality, body weight, cashflow, and warehouse inventory.
- LogiStack WMS: Enterprise Resource Planning for warehouse logistics, stock tracking, and import-export operations.
- Batam Rental Mobil: Online fleet reservation and booking management system with mobile-first responsiveness.
- Koperasi POS System: Point of sale, inventory, and accounting software for cooperatives and retail operations.
- Alyuna Siomay: Direct-to-consumer e-commerce ordering system with automated WhatsApp checkout integration.

## Key Services
- Fullstack Web Application Development: Custom dashboards, RESTful APIs, database schema design, and secure authentication.
- High-Converting Landing Page Development: Fast, mobile-first responsive web pages with SEO and WhatsApp lead capture.
- Business Intelligence & Data Analytics: Interactive analytics dashboards (Tableau, Power BI) and sales performance tracking.
- Machine Learning & Data Science: Predictive demand forecasting, customer clustering, and automated recommendation engines.
